note: Prompts tels qu’envoyés à Nano Banana 2.1. Les 100 images retenues : .claude/nmm-inspiration/flow-gothique-finale-2026-10-30/. La bulle 16 vient d’un premier gabarit, sans le nuage noir.
gabarit: Ink and wash drawing of {motif}. Behind everything, {fond}, dramatic chiaroscuro. Over it, {fil}, fine dry grain. Solemn, sacred, tender, silent. Abstract, never literal. Everything is held inside one large round watercolour disc, centred in the image and filling most of it, with a soft irregular edge, on pure white paper. Flat, no sphere, no 3D. Neutral grey only. Matte. No text, no frame, no figures, no faces, no skulls, no bones, no crosses, no buildings, no trees, no hair, no fur, no feathers.

fils.soie: thousands of long thin ink lines, fine as spider silk, drawn slowly with a pen, tapering and fading away, some dark, some scratched pale into the black
fils.griffe: thousands of thin pale lines scratched through the wet black with a needle
fils.sec: streaks of a fast dry brush, its bristles splitting into parallel threads with bare paper showing between them
fils.brume: thin arcs of fine sprayed droplets, nervous and wandering, like lines of mist flicked from a long wand
fils.fagot: whipped fans of fine lines flung from a bundle of twigs, thick where they land and thinning as they fly
fils.tremble: long trembling lines like a seismograph, thousands of tiny tremors, thin and vibrating
fils.grille: a broken grid of short straight wires, bent and misaligned, joined at uneven knots, frayed at its edges
fils.branche: thin branching filaments seen under a microscope, each dividing again, each one separate from the next, ending in tiny points
fils.reserve: pale filaments left unpainted in the dark, like shadows printed by sunlight
fils.boucle: one continuous looping line, drawn slowly with a long stick, overlapping itself
fils.eau: fine parallel lines of moving water, following the flow and bending around the eddy
fils.flottant: thin concentric ink rings stretched into moire waves, as in floating ink
fils.botte: coarse quick strokes of a bundled brush, dissolving into mist
fils.fouet: one thick and thin lash of black ink, with a few fine threads following it
fils.chanvre: long slightly wavy fibre strokes laid side by side, soft and patient
fils.pendu: thousands of fine threads hanging perfectly straight and parallel, in long even curtains
fils.rayon: hundreds of fine straight pencil lines radiating from hidden points and crossing into a soft moire
fils.une: one single unbroken line that never leaves the paper, folding back on itself
fils.flamme: thin streamers pulled long and fanning outward, finer and finer until they vanish
fils.etoile: long threads joining tiny bright knots, stretched around empty voids
fils.hachure: patient cross-hatching of fine pen lines, as in an old engraving, building the dark out of line alone

fonds.nuage: a deep soft cloud of wet black ink, smoky and velvety with no edge, fades into pale luminous mist
fonds.nuit: a vast dark velvet field fills almost the whole disc, leaving one small region of pale light
fonds.bas: a heavy black wash pooled low in the disc fades upward into pale luminous mist
fonds.haut: a heavy black sky of wet ink hangs at the top of the disc and fades downward into pale luminous mist
fonds.flanc: a dark wet cloud gathered on one side of the disc fades across into bare glowing paper
fonds.brume: pale grey mist fills the disc, with only one small soft dark mass
fonds.centre: a soft black mass gathered at the centre of the disc fades outward into pale luminous mist
fonds.voile: pale grey mist fills the disc, soft darker veils drifting slowly through it, nothing in focus
fonds.nuit2: a vast dark velvet field fills the whole disc, paler soft veils moving inside it, no bright spot
fonds.pale: soft wet clouds of grey ink drift across the disc, darker on one side, paler on the other, with no bright spot and no dark rim
